versions.changelog: Fix: image_size param only for gemini-3 models, prevents 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT on gemini-2.5-flash
Rich description with full usage command for agent system prompt
Added bash wrapper script (scripts/generate) that forces uv run
Based on official nano-banana-pro: same script structure, only added model fallback
Single-file design: uv run auto-installs deps, merged generate/edit/restore into one script
Zero dependencies: pure stdlib, no pip/uv needed

Initial release of nanobanana-pro, an AI image generation tool with automatic fallback.

- Generate, edit, or restore images using Gemini image models.
- Automatic fallback through multiple models if one fails (configurable via environment variable).
- Supports resolutions: 1K (default), 2K, and 4K.
- Command-line scripts for generation, editing (including multi-image), and restoration.
- Requires GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.
- OpenClaw integration with special outputs and config options.
